name: Robonaut 1 (R1)
summary: The first-generation Robonaut, developed by NASA's Johnson Space Center with DARPA from the late 1990s: a human-scale dexterous upper body with two 7-DOF arms and two five-fingered hands, built to approach the dexterity of a space-suited astronaut for teleoperated and semi-autonomous EVA tasks. It led directly to the ISS-flown Robonaut 2.
notable: First NASA humanoid, benchmark for space-tool dexterity
